q: £160 is shared between Ada and Ben in the ratio 6 : 10. How much does Ben receive?

steps.title: Simplify the ratio: divide both parts by 2
steps.note: 6 ÷ 2 = 3 and 10 ÷ 2 = 5. Dividing both parts by 2 keeps the same proportion.

steps.title: Match the known quantity to simplified parts
steps.note: The given total represents 8 parts in the simplified ratio.

steps.title: Find one simplified part
steps.note: Use 8 parts for the given total.

steps.title: Find the requested amount
steps.note: The requested second amount represents 5 simplified parts.

hint: Both ratio numbers divide by 2. Simplify both parts, then match the given total to the simplified parts.
method_note: 6 ÷ 2 = 3 and 10 ÷ 2 = 5. Dividing both parts by 2 keeps the same proportion. The given total represents 8 parts in the simplified ratio. Use 8 parts for the given total. The requested second amount represents 5 simplified parts.
check: The two amounts are 60 and 100. Dividing both by 20 gives 3 : 5, equivalent to 6 : 10.
error_note: £160 is the total for both people. Ben receives only his 5 of the 8 simplified parts.
repair: Find one of the 8 simplified parts, then multiply by Ben’s 5 parts.
